images_variants.name: images_variants
images_variants.value: case when jsonb_typeof("images"."variants") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("images"."variants") between 1 and 2 else false end

stories_reviewed_by.name: stories_reviewed_by
stories_reviewed_by.value: "stories"."reviewed_by" is null or "stories"."reviewed_at" is not null

stories_withdrawn_by.name: stories_withdrawn_by
stories_withdrawn_by.value: "stories"."withdrawn_by" is null or "stories"."withdrawn_at" is not null

stories_withdraw_note.name: stories_withdraw_note
stories_withdraw_note.value: "stories"."withdrawn_at" is null or btrim("stories"."withdraw_note_en") <> '' or btrim("stories"."withdraw_note_ur") <> ''
